description: Fluid Network Studio provides a browser-based pipe-network solver for flows, pressures and temperatures, with time-dependent tank, valve and pump behaviour. The provider is Fluid Network Studio. Geographical and temporal coverage: Networks are user-defined; the provider lists 31 verification cases but these were not rerun. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): commercial licence (Fluid Network Studio subscription). Free and paid access options are described. Caveats: Water and liquid simulation are advertised as free; gas, heat and non-Newtonian features use the Advanced offer. Closed-source status is inferred from the hosted commercial service, not a source-code audit. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
